summary.tldr: Lets some tradespersons and indentured apprentices deduct travel costs for certain construction jobs far from home.
what_it_does: Creates a new Income Tax Act deduction for travel costs to and from a construction job site that is at least 80 km from the worker’s ordinary home.
Limits the deduction to duly qualified tradespersons and indentured apprentices who were required by their employment contract to pay those costs.
Blocks the deduction if the worker received a non-taxable travel allowance or already claims the same costs under another tax deduction or credit.
Applies the change to the 2022 tax year and later.
who_it_affects: Construction workers at remote job sites
Employers with travel cost terms in contracts
